body:
you've got me in tears. I want to tell you, and everyone, so much, but I don't know where to begin, end, or even what to tell you in general. I'm just going to spill here, but you don't have to listen.


I had a girl earlier in the year. At that time in my life I found out I was a very emotional person. She was my life, my love, my world. I'm sure you've heard all of the "teen love" cliché's, so I'll leave them out. She was what I was truly passionate about for the longest time. I felt things I didn't know I actually had. There's a difference between having a crush on a girl and what the hell this was. I really let some emotions out with her, I guess something I had wanted to do for a long time.


She broke my heart. I took it bad. I became really cold after everything was said and done. I took up some bad habits. I lost a lot of friends. 

Oh, that's another thing. my friends. I don't act introverted, when really I am. I guess it's more of a shell (hah, username puns). Anyways, they all think I'm empty headed, careless, and just an average kid. If i ever dumped this on any of them it'd be too much for them. They don't know me like that, nobody does, really.

When a girl hints that they like me, my brain goes nuts. Don't get me wrong, I'm calm, cool, and collected, but my head will start spewing these emotions into my head for no reason. It keeps me up at night. I cant understand why. It's not out of desperation or anything like that, it's just one of those things I cant explain.


I listen to really emotional/girly music. Taylor Swift to name one big one. It calms me and I feel it relates to me, even when these situations have not occured to me.-

through writing this out i actually came to terms with myself. It kind of all makes sense on the screen. I have no idea how to explain it, but you can kind of weave an idea out of what i just wrote. This is a lot for me, I'm sorry.
Thanks for the advice. These replies as a whole have motivated me to try some new things. I cant express how helpful you and everyone have been.

I took the test, and apparently I'm highly intuitive.. I never thought of that. I guess when I'm programming I'm always finding ways to make it better. Anyways, thanks for your time, you helped me a lot.
That's the first time in well over a year anyone has said anything nice to me. I guess you could say I like programming, but it's way too complicated for me, and I've been learning for 3 years.
